title: console list page: the first data page is sometimes read twice, byte-identical, 150-380 ms apart
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Filing gate: ③ an out-of-scope finding of the #35455 dev (os-dev-report 7012178512), measured on `origin/main` `92121196` with the built console. It belongs to #35455's family (duplicate first-screen reads) and is nested under it.
Reader: `domain:ui` (list view data read; grid). Suggested grade: p2 (not on the path to first paint; a wasted round trip on a daily first screen).
Dedupe: `list data read twice`, `duplicate data read list page`, `populate top=50 sent twice`, `grid refetch after first page`. No open card.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；列表页首次打开时有时会把同一页数据取两次，修好后少一次请求。
- 为什么做：首屏请求提速工作中测到的重复读取。
- 出错会怎样：只影响请求次数；改错可能导致列表不刷新，撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Facts

- Showcase list page `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task`: on 4 of 8 loads, `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task?populate=project&top=50&select=…` was sent twice, 149-378 ms apart (e.g. 2097 and 2466 ms; 2138 and 2516 ms). On the load captured with full URLs the two are byte-identical.
- The first answer paints; the second is not on the path to first data.

## Ask

Find which consumer re-issues the read (likely a settle-then-refetch after a dependency such as the personal view or the view's sort settles, beyond the in-flight de-dup), make it read once, and pin it: one data read per cold list load, with a CONTROL that a real filter or sort change still reads again.

⛔ Not a claim.
